impairmentSummary: The local 2026 303(d) county summary shows about 318.7 river miles in not supporting categories, 287.2 fully supporting miles, and 425.2 not assessed miles in Sevier County.
sampleWaterbodies: Misc tribs to Little Pigeon River
cejstSummary: Using the local Justice40 / CEJST tract snapshot, 9 of 18 census tracts in Sevier County are flagged as disadvantaged (50.0%). 0 tracts carry the water and wastewater stress flag, and 1 tract carry the climate stress flag.

stressSummary.caveat: Water stressed and climate stressed are local labels for CEJST category flags. They are screening indicators, not direct measurements or regulatory determinations.

overview: Sevier County is represented as a East Tennessee county summary focused on county-scale watershed conditions, public-interest infrastructure context, and environmental screening indicators. It intersects Lower French Broad, Watts Bar Lake and overlaps 4 state legislative district labels plus 1 congressional district labels.
getInvolved: Review county and municipal agendas in Sevier County for stormwater, wastewater, landfill, quarry, and land-use decisions.
Use the county page to connect statewide indicators with local watersheds, monitoring stations, and source notes.
Check local monitoring and permit context alongside SEVIERVILLE WATER SYSTEM; SEVIER COUNTY WATER DEPARTMENT for community-specific follow-up.
